spans.s: (I)--a son of ब्रह्मा; remained a celibate. भा.
(II)--Mt. on the base (north-वि। प्।) of Meru. भा. V. १६. २६; Vi.
(III)--an अवतार् of Hari in कृतयुग; taught yoga to शनक and other sages in the presence of ब्रह्मा; called himself यज्ञ. भा.
(IV)--a son of Brahmadatta and brother of शाल्व; killed on the यमुना by कृष्ण. भा X. ७६. 2 [8]; ५२. [५६ (v) 8]; ५७. १४ [1].
(V)--the caste name of men in कृतयुग. भा. XI. १७. १०.
(VI)--one of the ten horses of the moon's chariot. Br. II. २३. ५७; M. १२६. ५२; वा. ५२. ५३.
